name: Teradyne

eyebrow.en: Teradyne, Inc. · Common stock · North Reading, Massachusetts
eyebrow.zh: 泰瑞达 · 普通股 · 马萨诸塞州北雷丁

title.en: The test every AI chip must pass, now twice the business it was a year ago.
title.zh: 每颗 AI 芯片必经的测试关卡，业务规模一年翻倍。

lede.en: Teradyne makes the machines that test chips before they ship, plus Universal Robots cobots and MiR mobile robots. AI demand lifted Q3 revenue 70% to $1.31B, above the top of guidance, with record memory and integrated-systems test and profitable Robotics. The catch is lumpiness and price: the Q4 guide of $1.25–1.35B is flat with Q3, inventory is rising, and the stock fell about 6% after hours on the report.
lede.zh: 泰瑞达生产芯片出厂前所用的测试设备，另有 Universal Robots 协作机器人和 MiR 移动机器人。AI 需求推动 Q3 营收增长 70% 至 13.1 亿美元，高于指引上限，存储与集成系统测试创纪录，机器人业务实现盈利。问题在于订单波动与估值：Q4 指引 12.5–13.5 亿美元，与 Q3 持平，库存上升，财报公布后股价盘后下跌约 6%。

s.zh: GAAP 每股 $8.71 · 按明年一致预期每股约 $10.84 约 30 倍

s.en: Q4 2026 and 2027 outlook · date not yet set
s.zh: 2026 第四季及 2027 展望 · 日期未定

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Teradyne has roughly doubled over the past year, but has swung between about $309 and $484 since June.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。泰瑞达过去一年股价约翻倍，但自6月以来收盘价在约 $309 至 $484 之间大幅波动。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Teradyne's fiscal year is the calendar year (quarters end on the Sunday nearest the month end). Revenue sat near $600–750M a quarter from 2023 to 2025, then jumped on AI test demand. The last bar is the $1.30B midpoint of Q4 2026 guidance.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。泰瑞达财年与日历年一致（季度结束于最接近月末的周日）。2023 至 2025 年季度营收约在 6–7.5 亿美元，之后因 AI 测试需求跃升。最后一根柱为 2026 年 Q4 指引中值 13.0 亿美元。

s.zh: 同比 +70% · 环比 −2% · 高于约 12.7 亿预期
连续第三季超过 10 亿 · 环比 −4%
史上最佳第三季 · 实现盈利
GAAP · 调整后 $2.29，预期约 $2.07 · 毛利率 59.1%

p.en: CEO Greg Smith said demand spanned the AI value chain, from memory and hard-disk-drive test to high-speed interconnect and robotics, lifting Q3 above the top of guidance.
p.zh: CEO 格雷格·史密斯表示，需求覆盖 AI 全产业链，从存储与硬盘测试到高速互连及机器人，推动 Q3 业绩高于指引上限。

p.en: Memory and Integrated Systems Test both set revenue records in Q3 on AI-related demand, after memory orders ran at over twice shipments in Q2.
p.zh: 受 AI 需求带动，存储测试与集成系统测试营收在 Q3 双双创纪录；此前 Q2 存储订单已达出货量的两倍以上。

p.en: The Q4 guide of $1.25–1.35B and $1.95–2.25 adjusted EPS beat consensus of about $1.28B and $2.03, but the midpoint is flat with Q3 and below Q2's $1.33B record. The call is on Oct 28.
p.zh: Q4 指引营收 12.5–13.5 亿美元、调整后每股 $1.95–2.25，高于约 12.8 亿和 $2.03 的预期，但中值与 Q3 持平，低于 Q2 的 13.3 亿纪录。电话会议于10月28日举行。

p.en: After a 2025 restructuring that cut about 150 jobs, Robotics posted its best Q3 at $96M and turned a profit. A U.S. factory is due to open later this year.
p.zh: 经过 2025 年裁员约 150 人的重组，机器人业务录得史上最佳第三季营收 9,600 万美元并实现盈利。美国工厂预计今年稍后投产。

p.en: Test spending moves in big, uneven waves tied to a few chip makers; revenue fell from $951M in Q3 2021 to $600M in Q1 2024. Inventory days rose to about 98 from 69 in Q2.
p.zh: 测试设备支出集中于少数芯片厂，波动大且不均；营收曾由 2021 年 Q3 的 9.51 亿美元降至 2024 年 Q1 的 6.0 亿。库存天数由 Q2 的 69 天升至约 98 天。

p.en: At about 37 times trailing GAAP earnings, the stock still prices in growth. It is about a third below its $488 high, and fell about 6% after hours despite the beat.
p.zh: 按过去四季 GAAP 盈利计约 37 倍，股价仍反映增长预期。股价较 $488 高点低约三分之一，财报超预期后盘后仍跌约 6%。

p.en: 8:30am ET (8:30pm SGT). Watch for comments on 2027 demand, compute order timing and inventory.
p.zh: 美东时间上午8:30（新加坡时间晚上8:30）。关注 2027 年需求、计算类订单时点与库存的说法。

p.en: Management said its U.S. manufacturing center for Robotics is on track to open later this year.
p.zh: 管理层表示机器人业务的美国制造中心按计划于今年稍后启用。

p.en: Guide: revenue $1.25–1.35B, adjusted EPS $1.95–2.25. Full-year 2026 results and the first read on 2027.
p.zh: 指引：营收 12.5–13.5 亿美元，调整后每股 $1.95–2.25。2026 全年业绩及对 2027 年的首次展望。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 28, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Teradyne, Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月28日（2026 年第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Teradyne, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Teradyne's fiscal year is the calendar year. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年 Q4 至 2026 年 Q3 共 20 个季度。泰瑞达财年与日历年一致。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 2026年9月27日 · 另有 1.64 亿有价证券 · 无负债

read.en: Teradyne's free cash flow is lumpy and often weakest in the first quarter: it was negative in Q1 2022, Q1 2023 and Q1 2024. The AI ramp changed the scale. Q3 2026 produced $227M on $314M of operating cash flow and $86M of capex, down from Q2's $378M record as inventory built, and the last four quarters add up to about $1.0B.
read.zh: 泰瑞达自由现金流波动大，第一季常为最弱：2022、2023 和 2024 年 Q1 均为负。AI 放量改变了规模。2026 年 Q3 经营现金流 3.14 亿美元、资本开支 8,600 万，自由现金流 2.27 亿，因库存增加低于 Q2 的 3.78 亿纪录；近四季合计约 10 亿美元。

read.en: My base case uses the $1.30B Q4 guide midpoint and a similar level into 2027, with capex near $85–90M a quarter and a seasonally weak Q1. That gives about $1.05B over four quarters. The main risk is order timing: a pause in compute or memory orders, with inventory already up, would cut revenue and cash quickly, as in 2023–24.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用 Q4 指引中值 13.0 亿美元，2027 年维持相近水平，资本开支每季约 8,500 万–9,000 万美元，Q1 季节性偏弱，四季合计约 10.5 亿美元。主要风险是订单时点：在库存已上升的情况下，计算或存储订单一旦暂停，营收与现金会迅速下滑，如 2023–24 年。

p.en: $0.13 a share, about $20M a quarter; $61M paid in the first nine months.
p.zh: 每股 $0.13，每季约 2,000 万美元；前三季共派 6,100 万。

p.en: Picked up to $99M in Q3, for $174M in the first nine months of 2026, versus $702M in 2025.
p.zh: Q3 回购增至 9,900 万美元，2026 年前三季合计 1.74 亿，2025 年全年为 7.02 亿。

p.en: Capex was $86M in Q3 and $242M in nine months; inventory days rose to about 98.
p.zh: Q3 资本开支 8,600 万美元，前三季 2.42 亿；库存天数升至约 98 天。

p.en: Semiconductor Test revenue topped $1B for a third straight quarter.
p.zh: 半导体测试营收连续第三季超过 10 亿美元。

p.en: Both set revenue records in Q3 on AI-related demand.
p.zh: 受 AI 需求带动，两者在 Q3 营收均创纪录。

p.en: Robotics turned profitable on its best Q3 revenue.
p.zh: 机器人业务以史上最佳第三季营收实现盈利。

bridgeNote.en: Teradyne has no debt and another $164M in marketable securities. Buybacks picked up in Q3 but remain well below 2025's pace, so cash could build if that holds; acquisitions are not in this bridge.
bridgeNote.zh: 泰瑞达无负债，另有 1.64 亿美元有价证券。Q3 回购回升，但仍远低于 2025 年的节奏，若此节奏持续，现金可能累积；本测算未计入并购。
